title: Supervised Model Evaluation Metrics Selection
description: Aligning quantitative model validation metrics with real-world clinical and business utility.
conditions: Final model scoring and comparison across candidate algorithms
Requirement to report performance to technical and non-technical stakeholders
recommended_methods: PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under Curve) and Brier Score for rare-event probability calibration
Macro-averaged and Weighted F1-Score for multiclass classification
Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) for continuous regression
selection_rules: If severe penalties exist for extreme regression errors, prioritize RMSE over MAE
If regression errors contain heavy outliers and median loss is preferred, prioritize MAE over RMSE
If model outputs probabilities used for downstream triage decisions, evaluate probability calibration curves
limitations: ROC-AUC can present an overly optimistic assessment on datasets with extreme class imbalance
R-squared in regression can be artificially inflated by adding irrelevant features
